description_en: Modifies the acceleration region for a domain name by specifying a property
description_zh: 调用ModifyDCdnDomainSchdmByProperty通过配置组修改域名的加速区域
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn modify-dcdn-domain-schdm-by-property --domain-name example.com --property coverage_:_overseas --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDCdnDomainSchdmByProperty

parameters.help_en: The domain name whose acceleration region you want to modify. You can specify only one domain name
parameters.help_zh: 需修改加速区域的域名，仅支持单个修改
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The properties of the acceleration region, such as {"coverage":"overseas"}. The coverage parameter can be set to one of the following values:

domestic: the Chinese mainland only.
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).
global: global
parameters.help_zh:
加速区域属性，{"coverage":"overseas"}。
其中coverage参数的取值如下：

domestic：仅中国内地。

overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）。

global：全球
parameters.name: property
